items.exampleEn: They had a romantic dinner by the sea.
items.exampleZh: 他們在海邊吃了一頓浪漫的晚餐。

items.exampleEn: It was wise to leave early.
I admire my mother for her hard work.
items.exampleZh: 我很欽佩我媽媽那麼努力。

items.exampleEn: She was upset because she lost her phone.
items.exampleZh: 她因為弄丟手機而很難過。

items.exampleEn: He is very gentle with animals.

items.sentenceEn: My parents are worried about me.

items.audioEn: We watched a horror movie last night, and my sister couldn't sleep.
items.audioZh: 我們昨晚看了一部恐怖片，我妹妹嚇得睡不著。
items.questionZh: 他們昨晚看了什麼電影？

items.sentenceEn: Please be gentle with the baby.
The boss was pleased with our work.
items.sentenceZh: 老闆對我們的工作很滿意。

items.stemEn: Don't be ____. Everything will be fine.
items.stemZh: 別擔心，一切都會沒事的。

items.stemEn: I really ____ people who help others.
items.stemZh: 我真的很欽佩那些幫助別人的人。

items.passageEn: My grandparents have been married for fifty years. My grandfather is a gentle and wise man. Every year, he plans something romantic for their anniversary. Last year, he took Grandma to the restaurant where they had their first date. Grandma was very pleased. When it started to rain, she was upset. "Don't worry," Grandpa said, and he opened a big umbrella. I really admire them.
items.passageZh: 我爺爺奶奶已經結婚五十年了。爺爺是個溫柔又有智慧的人。每年結婚紀念日，他都會安排浪漫的活動。去年，他帶奶奶去他們第一次約會的那家餐廳。奶奶非常高興。開始下雨的時候，她很心煩。爺爺說：「別擔心。」然後撐開一把大傘。我真的很欽佩他們。

questions.questionZh: 去年爺爺帶奶奶去哪裡？
options: 他們第一次約會的餐廳
他們以前一起讀的學校

questions.questionZh: 開始下雨時，爺爺做了什麼？

referenceEn: My sister is afraid of horror movies.
My younger sister is afraid of watching horror movies.
rubricZh: 「恐怖片」用 horror movies（寫 horror films 也可以）
「怕」可寫例如 is afraid of、is scared of

referenceEn: She is pleased with her new home.
She is very pleased with her new house.
rubricZh: 用 be pleased with 表示「對…滿意」
「新家」可寫，例如 new home、new house 等
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 is、was 等）
